abilities.name: Symbiote
abilities.text: Spawn and attach a Symbiote to a target ally or Structure. While active, Abathur controls the Symbiote, gaining access to new Abilities. The Symbiote is able to gain XP from nearby enemy deaths.

abilities.name: Toxic Nest
abilities.text:
Spawn a mine that becomes active after a short time. Deals 153 (+4% per level) damage and reveals the enemy for 4 seconds. Lasts 90 seconds.

Stores up to 3 charges.

abilities.name: Evolve Monstrosity
abilities.text:
Turn an allied Minion or Locust into a Monstrosity. When enemy Minions near the Monstrosity die, it gains 2% Health and 2% Basic Attack damage, stacking up to 40 times. The Monstrosity can be healed by Carapace and has the ability to Burrow to a visible location every 80 seconds.

Using Symbiote on the Monstrosity allows Abathur to control it, in addition to Symbiote's normal benefits. This Ability can be reactivated to automatically cast Symbiote on his Monstrosity.

abilities.name: Ultimate Evolution
abilities.text: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

abilities.name: Locust Strain
abilities.text:
Spawns a Locust to attack down the nearest lane every 15 seconds. Locusts heal for 20% of the damage they deal, and regain 20% of their Maximum health when a nearby minion dies.

Locusts lose health over 17 seconds, have 225 (+4% per level) health and deal 36 (+4% per level) damage with each Basic Attack, dealing 100% bonus damage to enemy non-Heroes.

abilities.name: Deep Tunnel
abilities.text: Quickly tunnel to a visible location.

abilities.name: Stab
abilities.text: Shoots a spike towards target area that deals 119 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy it contacts.

abilities.name: Spike Burst
abilities.text: Deals 120 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Carapace
abilities.text: Shields the assisted ally for 150 (+4% per level). Allied Heroes are healed for 22 (+4% per level) Health per second while the Shield is active. Lasts for 6 seconds.

1.text: Increases the range of Symbiote's Spike Burst by 25% and decreases the cooldown by 1 second.

1.name: Envenomed Nest
1.text: Toxic Nests deal 75% more damage over 3 seconds and reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit by 15 for 4 seconds.

1.name: Reinforced Carapace
1.text: Increase the Shield amount of Carapace by 40%.

1.name: Locust Brood
1.text: Activate to spawn 3 Locusts at a nearby location.

4.name: Adrenal Overload
4.text: Heroic Symbiote hosts gain 25% increased Attack Speed.

4.name: Needlespine
4.text: Increases the damage and range of Symbiote's Stab by 20%.

4.name: Prolific Dispersal
4.text: Increase the duration of Toxic Nests by 45 seconds, reduce its cooldown by 2 seconds, and add 2 additional charges.

4.name: Slapathur
4.text:
Abathur’s Basic Attacks deal 350% additional damage and Stun non-Elite enemies and disable Structures for 1.5 seconds.

The same Hero or Structure can only be Stunned or disabled once every 6 seconds.

7.name: Vile Nest
7.text: Toxic Nests Slow enemy Movement Speed by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

7.name: Networked Carapace
7.text: Using Symbiote's Carapace also applies an untalented Carapace Shield to all nearby allied Heroes, Minions, and Mercenaries.

7.name: Calldown: MULE
7.text: Activate to calldown a Mule that repairs Structures, one at a time, near target point for 40 seconds, healing for 90 Health every 1 second.

20.text: Increase the duration of Ultimate Evolution by 50%. As long as the Ultimate Evolution is alive, the original target of the clone gains a Shield equal to 35% of their maximum Health. Refreshes every 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Discord Strike
abilities.text: After a 0.5 second delay, enemies in front of Alarak take 165 (+4% per level) damage and are silenced for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.text:
Vector Targeting
Create a force, pushing Alarak and all enemies hit from the targeted point towards the targeted direction. Deals 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Lightning Surge
abilities.text: Deal 62 (+4% per level) damage to an enemy and an additional 100% damage to enemies between Alarak and the target. Restore 75 (+4% per level) health for each Hero hit.

abilities.name: Deadly Charge
abilities.text:
After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. Distance is increased based on the amount of time channeled, up to 1.5 seconds.

Issuing a Move order while this is channeling will cancel it at no cost. Taking damage will interrupt the channeling.

abilities.name: Counter-Strike
abilities.text: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage.

abilities.name: Sadism
abilities.text:
Alarak's Ability damage and self-healing are increased by 100% against enemy Heroes.

Repeatable Quest: Takedowns increase Sadism by 3%, up to 30%. Sadism gained from Takedowns is lost on death.

abilities.name: Summon Mount

1.text: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 40% Attack Speed and causes Basic Attacks to heal for 15% of the damage dealt, increased by 50% of Sadism's bonus when hitting Heroes. These effects last for 4 seconds.

1.name: Ruthless Momentum
1.text: Reduce the Mana cost of Telekinesis from 30 to 20. Telekinesis's cooldown recharges 100% faster while above 80% Health.

1.name: Extended Lightning
1.text:
Reduce Sadism by 10%.

Quest: Hit Heroes with the center of Lightning Surge.

Reward: After hitting 5 Heroes, increase Lightning Surge's range by 20%.

Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, Lightning Surge's center also Slows enemies by 40% for 2 seconds.

Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with the center of a single cast, increase Sadism by 10% and instantly gain all other Rewards.

4.name: Chaos Reigns
4.text:
Quest: Hit Heroes with Discord Strike.

Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, increase Discord Strike's damage by 60.

Reward: After hitting 2 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 60.

Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 100 and instantly gain all other Rewards.

4.name: Negatively Charged
4.text:
Increase the Lightning Surge damage bonus to enemies between Alarak and his victim to 175%.

Repeatable Quest: Each Hero hit by the center of Lightning Surge permanently increases the damage bonus by 5%.

4.name: Show of Force
4.text:
Heroes hit with 3 of Alarak's Abilities within 2 seconds take an additional 61 (+4% per level) damage and increase Sadism by 2%, stacking up to 20%.

Sadism gained from Show of Force is lost on death.

7.name: Dissonance
7.text: Increase Discord Strike's Silence duration by 0.75 seconds.

7.name: Hindered Motion
7.text: Telekinesis Slows enemies by 30% for 3 seconds.

7.name: Applied Force
7.text: Reduce Sadism by 10%, but Telekinesis pushes 15% further and has 15% increased range.

13.name: Blade of the Highlord
13.text:
Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Sadism by 2% stacking up to 40%.

Sadism gained from Blade of the Highlord is lost on death.

13.name: Pure Malice
13.text:
Increase Sadism by 10% any time an allied Hero dies, up to 40%.

Sadism gained from Pure Malice is lost on death.

13.name: Rite of Rak'Shir
13.text:
Activate to mark an enemy Hero for 300 seconds.

Hitting the marked Hero with Discord Strike increases Sadism by 3%. Killing the marked Hero increases Sadism by 5% and lowers the cooldown of Rite of Rak'Shir to 10 seconds.

Sadism gained from Rite of Rak'Shir is lost on death.

16.name: Lethal Onslaught
16.text: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 50% of Sadism's damage bonus to Alarak's Basic Attacks for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh this duration.

16.name: Lightning Barrage
16.text: Hitting an enemy Hero with the center of Lightning Surge allows it to be cast again for free on a different primary target within the next 3 seconds. This free cast cannot benefit from Lightning Barrage.

16.name: Mocking Strikes
16.text: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Alarak's Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds. This bonus is doubled against enemy Heroes who are Stunned, Silenced, Slowed, or Rooted.

20.name: Wrath of the Highlord
20.text:
If Deadly Charge was the selected Heroic, Heroes hit by Deadly Charge take bonus damage from Alarak's Abilities equal to 75% of Sadism's bonus damage for 4 seconds.

If Counter-Strike was the selected Heroic, its cooldown is reduced by 2.5 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by Alarak's Basic Abilities.

20.name: Might of the Highlord
20.text: Alarak gains access to both of his Heroic Abilities. This can be activated to change which Ability occupies the Heroic slot, with the other Ability using the Trait slot.

20.name: Last Laugh
20.text: Activate to teleport to the chosen location and remove all Roots, Slows, and damage over time effects. If Alarak fails to hit enemy Heroes 3 times with Basic Abilities within 4 seconds of using Last Laugh, his Health is reduced to 1.

20.name: Hasty Bargain
20.text: Activate to permanently reduce Alarak's Sadism by 4% and reset the cooldowns of his Basic Abilities.

abilities.name: Healing Dart
abilities.text: Fire a dart which heals the first allied Hero hit for 195 (+4% per level) Health. Does not affect full Health Heroes.

abilities.name: Biotic Grenade
abilities.text:
Toss a grenade at the target area. Allied Heroes hit are healed for 152 (+4% per level) Health and receive 25% increased healing from Ana for 4 seconds. Enemies hit take 60 (+4% per level) damage and receive 100% less healing for 1.75 seconds.

If Biotic Grenade does not hit any enemies, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and if Ana is the only target hit, reduce its cooldown by an additional 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Sleep Dart
abilities.text:
Fire a dart that puts the first enemy Hero hit to Sleep, Stunning them for 3 seconds. Sleep's effects end instantly if the target takes damage after the first 0.5 seconds.

Cannot be used on Vehicles.

abilities.name: Nano Boost
abilities.text:
Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.

Cannot be used on Ana.

abilities.name: Eye of Horus
abilities.text:
Assume a sniping position, gaining the ability to fire up to 6 specialized rounds with unlimited range. Rounds pierce allied and enemy Heroes but collide with enemy Structures in their path. Allies are healed for 225 (+4% per level) and enemies are damaged for 135 (+4% per level). Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

Ana is unable to move while Eye of Horus is active.

abilities.name: Shrike
abilities.text:
Basic Attacks apply a Dose to enemies, dealing 40 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds, plus additional damage equal to the current number of stacks on the target, stacking up to 5 times. Every 0.5 seconds, Ana is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Shrike.

Aim Down Sights

Activating Shrike reduces your Movement Speed by 25%, but increases the Range of Healing Dart and Sleep Dart by 25% while also allowing them to pierce one Hero. Lasts until canceled.

20.text: Increase Shrike's damage by 50%. While Aim Down Sights is active, gain 25 Armor.
